title: Spec-Gate Registry
description: Registry of one-line spec stubs for artifacts on gated canon surfaces (decision D7, adopted 2026-06-12). Checked fail-closed by FLOSS/scripts/spec_gate.py --check and advisorily by hook_post_write.py.

gated_surfaces.description: Workspace-relative directory prefixes whose files require registration.

entries.description: Workspace-relative forward-slash path -> spec stub entry.

spec.description: One-line statement of intent — the '-1 layer'. What is this artifact FOR?

spec_ref.description: Optional pointer to a fuller spec/design doc.

grandfathered.description: True when registered en masse at gate introduction (2026-06-12) without a deliberate spec pass. Backfill on next touch.

tier.description: ADR-18 Prior-Art & Reuse Gate tier. 1 = evidence record; 2 = evidence record plus an independent reuse review. An entry carrying a tier MUST also carry `reuse` unless `emergency` is true. Omitting the tier is an exemption, not a default, and `spec_gate.py --add` refuses it.

reuse.description: Prior-art evidence for this artifact. Shape is defined by docs/specs/reuse-gate.schema.json and enforced by scripts/spec_gate.py:_reuse_problems; do not restate it here.

emergency.description: Downgrades a missing reuse block to a warning until promotion. Retrospective reuse audit required before the artifact is generalized.

tier_exempt.description: Why this artifact carries no reuse tier. Required when `tier` and `grandfathered` are both absent (R2, 2026-09-02): before that date an omitted tier was a silent exemption, which held ADR-18's reuse gate to 9 of 109 registered artifacts. A reason, never a boolean -- a bare flag is an omitted tier wearing a hat.
